g.text: II. Commodity and value — dual character
article of wealth produced for exchange
realises the full value — no surplus value
Value cannot be found in the
It is a social property that
appears as a relation between things
Not a hidden essence inside labour.
equated when products exchange as values.
The abstraction is social and historical,
SPGB tailor: owns tools and product,
sells the coat at its value — no surplus value.
Simple determinations of commodity production. Value is a social relation, not a physical property.
